doc.title: Claude Williams interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 4, 1995

title: Closing remarks
summary: Woods thanks him and Williams says he'll play the festival at 6:00.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: And you have quite a reputation as playing that fiddle, too.
Man it’s so different. There’s a lot of good fiddle players, but we are all different.

I would say you have a distinctive voice on the instrument. Well thank you very much. It’s been a pleasure to interview you with a little help from our friends. And thank you and we look forward to catching one of your sets this weekend at the festival here.
Yeah, I’ll be on the scene about 6:00.
